sources.entry: Yalqen - Chromium-based developer browser with vertical tabs, a keyboard-first command bar and built-in ad blocking.

summary.one_liner: Yalqen is an open-source, keyboard-first Chromium browser for developers on macOS, with vertical tabs, a command bar, and built-in ad and tracker blocking.
summary.what_it_does: Yalqen is a Chromium-based web browser aimed at developers, with a minimal browser UI. It offers vertical tabs and a keyboard-driven command bar. It includes built-in ad and tracker blocking and developer tools. The README says macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon is supported and signed and notarized, installable via Homebrew cask or DMG. A Linux build is an experimental AppImage built from source. Windows is not yet supported.
use_cases: browsing with ad and tracker blocking
testing web apps in a Chromium browser
experimenting with a Linux AppImage browser build
notable: Vertical tabs with a keyboard-first command bar
Signed and notarized macOS build installable via Homebrew cask or DMG
Experimental Linux AppImage built from source, initially tested on Ubuntu with GNOME Wayland
caveats: Linux support is an experimental preview; automatic updates are not verified on Linux and no ready-made Linux packages are published
macOS support is limited to macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon
